description: Search Brazilian federal laws by number/year or full-text words. Filter by type, year and issuing body (authority). Results preserve source attribution. Follow next; do not infer current legal validity. Full-text search covers title, description and body. Number/year uses an exact indexed lookup. Source metadata is not a verification of legal currency. No state or municipal laws in this collection.

after.description: Cursor from next. Do not generate a cursor.

authority.description: Issuing body declared by the source: congresso-nacional, presidencia-da-republica or unknown. The provider is separate.

q.description: Number/year, such as 10406/2002, or words. At most 160 characters. LGPD, CDC and Código Civil aliases are supported.

type.description: constituicao, leis-ordinarias, leis-complementares, leis-delegadas or decretos-lei.

name: search_legislation
title: Search legislation
